snippet.title: Tailgate Demo Teaser 2025 EN
snippet.description:
This is a new teaser for Tailgate's upcoming demo. Demo will feature a single chapter which also will be game's first chapter. It shows a bit of story and some core gameplay. Wishlist Tailgate on Steam to get notified about demo release and other news.

Wishlist Tailgate on Steam
👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3046820/Tailgate
Join Tailgate Discord
👉   / https://discord.gg/AfheT2np

What Tailgate is:
It's a story of Hyde, an aging labrador retriever, who wakes up and realizes that Derek, his beloved Human has disappeared. The doggo reluctantly leaves the house to investigate, only to find himself in the middle of an ancient dog prophecy.

What Tailgate is not: a dog sim. While there are mechanics that are definitely doggo like sniffing, borking and eating stuff of the ground, it is a narrative driven game about loneliness and loyalty.
